## What changed?

Tell us what you changed and which reader problem it solves.

## How did you check it?

- [ ] I ran `make scheduler-free`.
- [ ] I previewed the site when navigation, styling, or diagrams changed.
- [ ] I rebuilt generated downloads with `make release-assets` when anything
      under `examples/` or `docs/assets/downloads/` changed.

## Quick public-safety check

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, real shortcodes, PHI, restricted
      paths, sensitive logs, private discussion notes, or project details.
- [ ] Any cluster limit or policy change links to the current official source
      and includes the date it was checked.
- [ ] Commands shown as runnable are complete; illustrative fragments are
      labeled as templates.

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to?
